entry.title: What Remains OOD? OODConceptBench and Lexical Calibration for Zero-Shot Vision-Language OOD Detection
entry.summary: Negative-label zero-shot OOD detectors such as NegLabel mine large WordNet noun corpora with CLIP text-image similarity, yet static negative lexicons suffer from lexical polysemy and near-synonym collisions with ID classes, inflating FPR95 on fine-grained benchmarks. Using a training-free single-GPU evaluation pipeline on CLIP-ViT-B/16 across ImageNet-1K and 4 standard OOD datasets, OODConceptBench audits residual false positives and introduces lexical collision pruning, reducing average FPR95 by 4.6% and reaching 95.1% AUROC. Code and lexical lists at https://github.com/ood-concept/OODConceptBench .
